title: Notify the EPA of contaminated land
what: Notify the EPA in writing of site contamination that affects or threatens underground water, as owner or occupier of the site (or as its auditor or consultant).

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person to whom this section applies must notify the Authority in writing as soon as reasonably practicable after becoming aware of the existence of site contamination at the site or in the vicinity of the site (whether arising before or after the commencement of this section) that affects or threatens

reach.condition: if it owns or occupies a site with contamination that affects or threatens underground water
